display_name: AIA — Part II Medical Report (attending doctor)

fields.label: Hospitalisation details
fields.description: If the patient was hospitalised, the details of that admission. Leave missing if not hospitalised.

fields.label: Hospital admitted to
fields.description: Name of the hospital the patient was admitted to

fields.label: Date of admission
fields.description: Date the patient was admitted (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Date of discharge
fields.description: Date the patient was discharged (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Attending doctor(s)
fields.description: Name(s) of the attending doctor(s), if stated in the notes

fields.label: Type of treatment / surgery
fields.description: Type of treatment or surgery performed

fields.label: Surgical code
fields.description: Surgical operation code, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Name of doctor(s)
fields.description: Name of the doctor who performed the treatment or surgery

fields.label: Date of treatment
fields.description: Date the treatment or surgery was performed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Other doctor for same condition
fields.description: Name and address of any other doctor who treated the patient for this same condition

fields.label: Date of that consultation
fields.description: Date of consultation with that other doctor (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Previous serious condition
fields.description: Diagnosis or illness the patient was previously treated for, if the notes mention any prior serious condition

fields.label: Doctor for previous condition
fields.description: Name and address of the doctor who treated that previous condition

fields.label: Date of previous diagnosis
fields.description: Date that previous condition was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Diagnostic test(s)
fields.description: Diagnostic tests or scans performed, e.g. CT abdomen, full blood count

fields.label: Test result(s)
fields.description: Results of those diagnostic tests or scans

fields.label: Date of test
fields.description: Date the diagnostic test was performed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Complications prolonging healing
fields.description: Any complications that prolonged healing. Leave missing if the notes record none.

fields.label: Possibility of relapse
fields.description: Whether a relapse is possible, and the details if so. Leave missing unless the notes address it.

fields.label: Referring doctor
fields.description: Name of the doctor who referred the patient to you, if the notes mention a referral

fields.label: Referring clinic / hospital
fields.description: Name and address of the referring doctor's clinic or hospital

fields.label: Physiotherapist
fields.description: Name of the physiotherapist the patient was referred to, if any

fields.label: Physiotherapy clinic
fields.description: Name and address of the physiotherapy clinic or hospital

fields.label: Patient's regular doctor
fields.description: Name of the patient's regular doctor, if you are not their regular doctor

fields.label: Regular doctor's clinic
fields.description: Name and address of the regular doctor's clinic or hospital

fields.label: Date of accident
fields.description: Date the accident occurred (DD/MM/YYYY). Leave missing if this is an illness, not an accident.

fields.label: Time of accident
fields.description: Time the accident occurred, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Date of first consultation for injury
fields.description: Date of the first consultation for this injury (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: How the accident occurred
fields.description: Description of how the accident occurred

fields.label: Injuries and anatomical site
fields.description: The injuries sustained and the anatomical site involved

fields.label: Diagnosis (accident)
fields.description: The exact diagnosis of the condition resulting from the accident

fields.label: ICD-10-AM code
fields.description: ICD-10-AM code for the diagnosis, if stated or clearly implied

fields.label: Date of diagnosis
fields.description: Date the condition was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Injury consistent with the accident
fields.description: Whether the injury sustained is consistent with the accident described. Elaborate only if it is not.

fields.label: Cause of the injury
fields.description: The cause of the injury

fields.label: Alcohol / drug consumed
fields.description: Type of alcohol or drug consumed at the time of the accident. Leave missing unless the notes state the patient was under the influence.

fields.label: Blood alcohol level / quantity
fields.description: Blood alcohol level or quantity consumed, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Contributing illness / infirmity
fields.description: Any pre-existing illness or infirmity that contributed to the injury or prolonged the disability. Leave missing if the notes record none.

fields.label: Date that illness was diagnosed
fields.description: Date the contributing illness was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Doctor consulted for that illness
fields.description: Name and address of the doctor(s) consulted for the contributing illness

fields.label: How the illness contributed
fields.description: How the illness or infirmity contributed to the injuries or prolonged the disability

fields.label: Usual recovery time without it
fields.description: What the usual recovery time would have been if not for that illness or infirmity

fields.label: Total disability — start date
fields.description: Start of the period the patient could not perform any duties of their occupation (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Total disability — end date
fields.description: End of the period the patient could not perform any duties of their occupation (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Partial disability — start date
fields.description: Start of the period the patient could perform some but not all duties (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Partial disability — end date
fields.description: End of the period the patient could perform some but not all duties (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Medical certificates issued
fields.description: Whether medical certificates were issued for the stated period. Elaborate only if they were not.

fields.label: Fully recovered from injuries
fields.description: Whether the patient has fully recovered from the injuries. Elaborate only if they have not.

fields.label: Permanent loss of use
fields.description: Whether the injuries caused permanent and total loss of use of the organ or limb. If not, state the extent of loss of use.

fields.label: Prevented from working
fields.description: Whether the injuries would have prevented the patient from working in their occupation, and how

fields.label: Date of first consultation
fields.description: Date the patient FIRST consulted you for this condition (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Signs and symptoms at first visit
fields.description: The signs and symptoms the patient presented with at the first consultation

fields.label: Date symptoms first noticed
fields.description: Date the patient first noticed the symptoms of the diagnosed condition (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: How long symptoms lasted before consulting
fields.description: In your opinion, how long the symptoms had lasted before the first consultation

fields.label: Diagnosis (illness)
fields.description: The exact diagnosis of the condition

fields.label: ICD-10-AM code
fields.description: ICD-10-AM code for the diagnosis, if stated or clearly implied

fields.label: Date of diagnosis
fields.description: Date the condition was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Date patient was informed
fields.description: Date the patient was informed of the diagnosis (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Advice given to the patient
fields.description: What advice you gave the patient

fields.label: Underlying cause of the condition
fields.description: The underlying condition causing the diagnosed condition, if the notes identify one

fields.label: Date underlying condition diagnosed
fields.description: Date the underlying condition was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Urgent remedial treatment required
fields.description: Whether the condition required urgent remedial treatment to avoid death or serious impairment, elaborating if so

fields.label: Patient aware of condition beforehand
fields.description: Whether the patient was already aware of the condition before seeing you, elaborating if so

fields.label: Other doctor consulted beforehand
fields.description: Name of any other doctor the patient consulted for these symptoms before seeing you

fields.label: That doctor's clinic / hospital
fields.description: Name and address of that doctor's clinic or hospital

fields.label: Date of that consultation
fields.description: Date of that earlier consultation (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Fully recovered from the illness
fields.description: Whether the patient has fully recovered from the illness. Elaborate only if they have not.

fields.label: Other contributing illness
fields.description: Any other illness that would have contributed to the patient's condition. Leave missing if the notes record none.

fields.label: Date that illness was diagnosed
fields.description: Date the other contributing illness was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Doctor who made that diagnosis
fields.description: Name and address of the doctor who diagnosed that other illness

fields.label: Date patient informed of that diagnosis
fields.description: Date the patient was informed of that other diagnosis (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Your name (attending doctor)
fields.description: Name of the attending doctor completing and signing this report, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Your MCR number
fields.description: The attending doctor's Medical Council Registration (MCR) number, only if stated in the notes
